name: SYOKUSYULIEN -Ingoku no Daichi-
source:
The city is in catastrophe due to a mysterious phenomenon. It's a revival of the dead. Miki is a freelance camerawoman, who secretly enters the city. She sees a lot of girls being raped by the dead and get infected. She somehow runs away from them, and arrives at a tower. Will she be able to get out of the city...?

[From ErogeShop]
